```{r setup, include=FALSE}
figure_dir <- file.path(tempdir(), "nma-report-5-figures")
dir.create(figure_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
if (!dir.exists(figure_dir) || file.access(figure_dir, 2) != 0) {
  stop("Cannot write to the temporary figure directory: ", figure_dir)
}
figure_dir <- normalizePath(figure_dir, winslash = "/", mustWork = TRUE)
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  fig.path = paste0(figure_dir, "/"),
  echo = FALSE,
  warning = FALSE,
  message = FALSE,
  fig.width = 10,
  fig.height = 5,
  dpi = 150
)

library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(igraph)
library(knitr)
library(patchwork)
library(purrr)
library(scales)
library(tnet)
library(tidyr)

input_file <- knitr::current_input(dir = TRUE)
input_dir <- if (length(input_file) == 1L && nzchar(input_file)) {
  dirname(input_file)
} else {
  getwd()
}
project_file <- "NMA network structure analysis.Rproj"
report_dir <- if (file.exists(file.path(input_dir, project_file))) {
  input_dir
} else if (file.exists(file.path(input_dir, "..", project_file))) {
  normalizePath(file.path(input_dir, ".."), winslash = "/", mustWork = TRUE)
} else {
  stop("Open NMA network structure analysis.Rproj before running this report.")
}
empirical_result_dir <- file.path(report_dir, "Empirical data", "results")
comparison_result_dir <- file.path(
  report_dir, "Report 5 - Clinical topic comparisons", "results"
)
dir.create(comparison_result_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

empirical_networks_file <- file.path(
  empirical_result_dir,
  "empirical_incidence_networks.rds"
)
metric_functions_file <- file.path(
  report_dir, "Common R functions", "metric_functions.R"
)
field_metadata_file <- file.path(
  report_dir, "Empirical data", "metadata", "network_summary_report.csv"
)

if (!file.exists(empirical_networks_file)) {
  stop("Empirical network file not found: ", empirical_networks_file)
}
if (!file.exists(metric_functions_file)) {
  stop("Metric functions file not found: ", metric_functions_file)
}
if (!file.exists(field_metadata_file)) {
  stop("Clinical Topic metadata file not found: ", field_metadata_file)
}

plot_theme <- theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 11),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 9),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank()
  )
theme_set(plot_theme)
significance_threshold <- 0.10
minimum_field_size <- 25L
```

# Aim and data boundary

This report reproduces the comparison of networks across Clinical Topics using
only the 300 empirical networks. Clinical Topic codes are read from the empirical
database summary, but no metric value is read from that file. All retained
metrics are recomputed during rendering from the saved empirical incidence
matrices by `compute_metrics_for_networks()` in `metric_functions.R`.

For this analysis, a Clinical Topic is included in the comparison when it
contains at least `r minimum_field_size` empirical networks. Each selected
Clinical Topic is also compared with the distribution across all 300 empirical
networks. The latter comparisons are exploratory because a selected Clinical
Topic is a subset of the overall empirical distribution.

# Read and validate empirical inputs

```{r read-and-validate}
source(metric_functions_file)
empirical_networks <- readRDS(empirical_networks_file)
empirical_metrics <- compute_metrics_for_networks(empirical_networks)
field_metadata <- read.csv(
  field_metadata_file,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
  check.names = FALSE
) %>%
  select(network_id, field) %>%
  distinct()

if (anyDuplicated(empirical_metrics$network_id)) {
  stop("network_id is not unique in empirical_metrics.rds.")
}
if (anyDuplicated(field_metadata$network_id)) {
  stop("network_id is not unique in the Clinical Topic metadata.")
}
if (!"network_id" %in% names(empirical_metrics)) {
  stop("Computed empirical metrics must contain network_id.")
}

unmatched_metrics <- anti_join(
  empirical_metrics %>% select(network_id),
  field_metadata,
  by = "network_id"
)
if (nrow(unmatched_metrics) > 0L) {
  stop("Some empirical networks have no Clinical Topic classification.")
}

mean_degree_metric_names <- c(
  "mean_unipartite_unweighted_degree",
  "mean_bipartite_trial_degree",
  "mean_bipartite_treatment_degree"
)

metric_names <- c(
  "density",
  "bi_density",
  mean_degree_metric_names,
  "avg_path_length",
  "unipartite_c",
  "assortativity",
  "bi_assortativity",
  "deg_irreg",
  "bi_trial_deg_irreg",
  "bi_treatment_deg_irreg",
  "N_treatments",
  "N_total_trials",
  "number_of_arms",
  "number_of_distinct_treatment_comparisons"
)
missing_metrics <- setdiff(metric_names, names(empirical_metrics))
if (length(missing_metrics) > 0L) {
  stop(
    "Requested metrics are missing from metric_functions.R output: ",
    paste(missing_metrics, collapse = ", ")
  )
}
non_numeric_metrics <- metric_names[
  !vapply(empirical_metrics[metric_names], is.numeric, logical(1))
]
if (length(non_numeric_metrics) > 0L) {
  stop(
    "Metric columns must be numeric: ",
    paste(non_numeric_metrics, collapse = ", ")
  )
}

analysis_data <- empirical_metrics %>% 
  inner_join(field_metadata, by = "network_id") # %>% 
  #subset(field<=26)

stopifnot(nrow(analysis_data) == nrow(empirical_metrics))
```

The analysis contains `r nrow(analysis_data)` empirical networks and the
`r length(metric_names)` retained metrics computed by `metric_functions.R`.
`N_total_trials` is reported as the number of trials.
The number of arms counts trial--treatment edges in the bipartite graph;
the number of distinct treatment comparisons counts unique edges in the
unipartite treatment projection.

# Clinical Topic labels and eligible Clinical Topics

```{r field-labels}
icd_labels_1_26 <- c(
  "Certain infectious or parasitic diseases",
  "Neoplasms",
  "Diseases of the blood or blood-forming organs",
  "Diseases of the immune system",
  "Endocrine, nutritional or metabolic diseases",
  "Mental, behavioural or neurodevelopmental disorders",
  "Sleep-wake disorders",
  "Diseases of the nervous system",
  "Diseases of the visual system",
  "Diseases of the ear or mastoid process",
  "Diseases of the circulatory system",
  "Diseases of the respiratory system",
  "Diseases of the digestive system",
  "Diseases of the skin",
  "Diseases of the musculoskeletal system or connective tissue",
  "Diseases of the genitourinary system",
  "Conditions related to sexual health",
  "Pregnancy, childbirth or the puerperium",
  "Certain conditions originating in the perinatal period",
  "Developmental anomalies",
  "Symptoms, signs or clinical findings, not elsewhere classified",
  "Injury, poisoning or certain other consequences of external causes",
  "External causes of morbidity or mortality",
  "Factors influencing health status or contact with health services",
  "Codes for special purposes",
  "Supplementary Clinical Topic Traditional Medicine Conditions - Module I"
)

field_lookup <- tibble(
  field = 1:30,
  field_label_full = c(
    paste0(sprintf("%02d", 1:26), ": ", icd_labels_1_26),
    "Dentistry", "Education", "Other medical", "Other non-medical"
  ),
  field_label_short = c(
    sprintf("%02d", 1:26),
    "Dentistry", "Education", "Other medical", "Other non-medical"
  )
)

analysis_data <- analysis_data %>%
  left_join(field_lookup, by = "field") %>%
  mutate(
    field_label_full = if_else(
      is.na(field_label_full), sprintf("%02d", field), field_label_full
    ),
    field_label_short = if_else(
      is.na(field_label_short), sprintf("%02d", field), field_label_short
    )
  )

field_counts <- analysis_data %>%
  count(field, field_label_full, field_label_short, name = "n_networks") %>%
  arrange(field)

selected_fields <- field_counts %>%
  filter(n_networks >= minimum_field_size)
field_levels <- selected_fields$field_label_short

write.csv(
  field_counts,
  file.path(comparison_result_dir, "empirical_field_counts.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

selected_fields %>%
  select(field, n_networks, field_label_full, field_label_short) %>%
  kable(
    col.names = c(
      "Clinical Topic code", "Number of networks",
      "Full Clinical Topic label", "Plot label"
    ),
    caption = paste(
      "Empirical Clinical Topics with at least", minimum_field_size, "networks"
    )
  )
```


# Analysis data

```{r prepare-analysis-data}
metric_labels <- c(
  density = "Density (Unipartite)",
  bi_density = "Density (Bipartite)",
  mean_unipartite_unweighted_degree = "Mean treatment degree (Unipartite)",
  mean_bipartite_trial_degree = "Mean trial degree (Bipartite)",
  mean_bipartite_treatment_degree = "Mean treatment degree (Bipartite)",
  avg_path_length = "Average path length (Unipartite)",
  unipartite_c = "Clustering coefficient (Unipartite)",
  assortativity = "Degree assortativity (Unipartite)",
  bi_assortativity = "Degree assortativity (Bipartite)",
  deg_irreg = "Degree irregularity (Unipartite)",
  bi_trial_deg_irreg = "Trial-degree irregularity (Bipartite)",
  bi_treatment_deg_irreg = "Treatment-degree irregularity (Bipartite)",
  N_treatments = "Number of treatments",
  N_total_trials = "Number of trials",
  number_of_arms = "Number of arms (bipartite edges)",
  number_of_distinct_treatment_comparisons =
    "Number of distinct treatment comparisons (unipartite edges)"
)

missing_labels <- setdiff(metric_names, names(metric_labels))
if (length(missing_labels) > 0L) {
  metric_labels[missing_labels] <- gsub("_", " ", missing_labels)
}

field_palette <- setNames(hue_pal()(length(field_levels)), field_levels)
overall_fill <- "grey70"

distribution_label_lookup <- c(
  "02" = "Neoplasms",
  "06" = "Mental Health",
  "11" = "Circulation",
  "13" = "Digestion",
  "21" = "Symptoms"
)
distribution_field_levels <- recode(
  field_levels,
  !!!distribution_label_lookup,
  .default = field_levels
)
distribution_palette <- setNames(
  unname(field_palette[field_levels]),
  distribution_field_levels
)

metric_long <- analysis_data %>%
  select(
    network_id, field, field_label_full, field_label_short,
    all_of(metric_names)
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = all_of(metric_names),
    names_to = "metric",
    values_to = "value"
  ) %>%
  filter(is.finite(value))

field_metric_long <- metric_long %>%
  filter(field %in% selected_fields$field) %>%
  mutate(
    field_label_short = factor(field_label_short, levels = field_levels)
  )

overall_metric_long <- metric_long %>%
  transmute(network_id, metric, value, field_label_short = "Overall")

boxplot_metric_long <- bind_rows(
  field_metric_long %>%
    select(network_id, metric, value, field_label_short),
  overall_metric_long
) %>%
  mutate(
    field_label_short = factor(
      field_label_short,
      levels = c(field_levels, "Overall")
    )
  )

distribution_field_metric_long <- field_metric_long %>%
  mutate(
    field_label_plot = recode(
      as.character(field_label_short),
      !!!distribution_label_lookup,
      .default = as.character(field_label_short)
    ),
    field_label_plot = factor(
      field_label_plot,
      levels = distribution_field_levels
    )
  )

distribution_boxplot_metric_long <- boxplot_metric_long %>%
  mutate(
    field_label_plot = recode(
      as.character(field_label_short),
      !!!distribution_label_lookup,
      .default = as.character(field_label_short)
    ),
    field_label_plot = factor(
      field_label_plot,
      levels = c(distribution_field_levels, "Overall")
    )
  )
```

# Trial--treatment dimensions

The grey layer shows the joint \((M,N)\) distribution across all empirical
networks. The colored layer identifies the five selected Clinical Topics. Here, \(M\)
is the number of trials and \(N\) is the number of treatments; point area is
proportional to the number of networks at the same \((M,N)\) coordinate.

```{r field-MN-scatter, fig.width=8, fig.height=6}
overall_mn_counts <- analysis_data %>%
  transmute(
    M = N_total_trials,
    N = N_treatments
  ) %>%
  filter(is.finite(M), is.finite(N), M > 0, N > 0) %>%
  count(M, N, name = "n_networks")

field_mn_counts <- analysis_data %>%
  filter(field %in% selected_fields$field) %>%
  transmute(
    field_label_short = factor(field_label_short, levels = field_levels),
    M = N_total_trials,
    N = N_treatments
  ) %>%
  filter(is.finite(M), is.finite(N), M > 0, N > 0) %>%
  count(field_label_short, M, N, name = "n_networks")

mn_scatter_plot <- ggplot() +
  geom_point(
    data = overall_mn_counts,
    aes(
      x = N,
      y = M,
      size = n_networks,
      fill = "All networks"
    ),
    shape = 21,
    color = "grey45",
    stroke = 0.3,
    alpha = 0.55
  ) +
  geom_point(
    data = field_mn_counts,
    aes(
      x = N,
      y = M,
      size = n_networks,
      fill = field_label_short
    ),
    shape = 21,
    color = "white",
    stroke = 0.35,
    alpha = 0.85
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c("All networks" = "grey75", field_palette),
    breaks = c("All networks", field_levels),
    drop = FALSE,
    name = "Network set"
  ) +
  scale_size_area(
    max_size = 10,
    breaks = scales::breaks_pretty(n = 4),
    name = "Networks at (M,N)"
  ) +
  scale_x_log10(
    limits = c(4, NA),
    breaks = c(4, 5, 10, 20, 50),
    labels = label_number()
  ) +
  scale_y_log10(
    limits = c(2, NA),
    breaks = c(2, 5, 10, 20, 50, 100, 200),
    labels = label_number()
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Trial--treatment dimensions by selected Clinical Topic",
    x = expression(N~"(number of treatments)"),
    y = expression(M~"(number of trials)")
  ) +
  guides(
    fill = guide_legend(
      order = 1,
      title.position = "top",
      nrow = 2,
      byrow = TRUE,
      override.aes = list(size = 4)
    ),
    size = guide_legend(
      order = 2,
      title.position = "top",
      nrow = 1,
      override.aes = list(
        fill = "grey70",
        color = "grey45",
        alpha = 1
      )
    )
  ) +
  theme(
    legend.box = "vertical",
    legend.box.just = "center"
  )

print(mn_scatter_plot)
```

# Summary statistics

```{r metric-summary}
summary_table <- boxplot_metric_long %>%
  group_by(metric, field_label_short) %>%
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    mean = mean(value),
    sd = sd(value),
    median = median(value),
    q1 = quantile(value, 0.25),
    q3 = quantile(value, 0.75),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(metric_label = unname(metric_labels[metric])) %>%
  select(metric, metric_label, field_label_short, everything())

write.csv(
  summary_table,
  file.path(comparison_result_dir, "empirical_field_metric_summary.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)
```

The table below reports each metric as the median, with the interquartile
range (IQR) in parentheses, for all empirical networks and for each of the
five selected Clinical Topics.

```{r median-iqr-table, results='asis'}
metric_table_layout <- tribble(
  ~metric,                              ~metric_group,             ~network_type,
  "density",                           "Density",                 "Unipartite",
  "bi_density",                        "Density",                 "Bipartite",
  "mean_unipartite_unweighted_degree", "Mean degree",             "Unipartite (treatments)",
  "mean_bipartite_trial_degree",       "Mean degree",             "Bipartite (trial)",
  "mean_bipartite_treatment_degree",   "Mean degree",             "Bipartite (treatments)",
  "unipartite_c",                      "Clustering coefficient",  "Unipartite",
  "avg_path_length",                   "Average path length",     "Unipartite",
  "assortativity",                     "Degree assortativity",    "Unipartite",
  "bi_assortativity",                  "Degree assortativity",    "Bipartite",
  "deg_irreg",                         "Degree irregularity",     "Unipartite",
  "bi_trial_deg_irreg",                "Degree irregularity",     "Bipartite (trial)",
  "bi_treatment_deg_irreg",            "Degree irregularity",     "Bipartite (treatments)",
  "N_treatments",                      "Network size",             "Treatments",
  "N_total_trials",                    "Network size",             "Trials",
  "number_of_arms",                    "Number of edges",          "Bipartite (arms)",
  "number_of_distinct_treatment_comparisons", "Number of edges", "Unipartite (distinct comparisons)"
)

metric_table_digits <- setNames(
  rep(2L, length(metric_names)),
  metric_names
)
metric_table_digits[c(
  "N_treatments", "N_total_trials", "number_of_arms",
  "number_of_distinct_treatment_comparisons"
)] <- 1L

format_table_number <- function(x, digits) {
  if (!is.finite(x)) {
    return("&mdash;")
  }
  formatC(x, format = "f", digits = digits)
}

median_iqr_long <- summary_table %>%
  inner_join(metric_table_layout, by = "metric") %>%
  mutate(
    metric_order = match(metric, metric_table_layout$metric),
    field_label_short = as.character(field_label_short),
    digits = unname(metric_table_digits[metric]),
    median_iqr = pmap_chr(
      list(median, q1, q3, digits),
      function(median_value, q1_value, q3_value, digits_value) {
        paste0(
          format_table_number(median_value, digits_value),
          " (",
          format_table_number(q3_value - q1_value, digits_value),
          ")"
        )
      }
    )
  )

table_field_levels <- c("Overall", field_levels)

median_iqr_wide <- median_iqr_long %>%
  select(
    metric_order, metric_group, network_type,
    field_label_short, median_iqr
  ) %>%
  complete(
    nesting(metric_order, metric_group, network_type),
    field_label_short = table_field_levels,
    fill = list(median_iqr = "&mdash;")
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    field_label_short = factor(
      field_label_short,
      levels = table_field_levels
    )
  ) %>%
  arrange(metric_order, field_label_short) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = field_label_short,
    values_from = median_iqr
  ) %>%
  arrange(metric_order)

write.csv(
  median_iqr_wide %>%
    select(-metric_order) %>%
    mutate(across(everything(), ~ gsub("&mdash;", "NA", .x))),
  file.path(
    comparison_result_dir,
    "empirical_field_metric_median_iqr.csv"
  ),
  row.names = FALSE
)

median_iqr_display <- median_iqr_wide %>%
  filter(
    metric_order %in% match(metric_names, metric_table_layout$metric)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    metric_group = if_else(
      duplicated(metric_group),
      "",
      paste0("<strong>", metric_group, "</strong>")
    ),
    across(
      all_of(table_field_levels),
      ~ sub(" ", "<br>", .x, fixed = TRUE)
    )
  ) %>%
  select(-metric_order)

kable(
  median_iqr_display,
  format = "html",
  escape = FALSE,
  align = c("l", "l", rep("c", length(table_field_levels))),
  col.names = c("Metric", "Network", table_field_levels),
  caption = "Network metrics reported as median (IQR).",
  table.attr = paste0(
    'id="tab:metrics_median_iqr" ',
    'class="table table-condensed" ',
    'style="width:100%; font-size:90%;"'
  )
)
```

# Statistical comparisons

For each numeric metric, the Kruskal--Wallis test compares the selected Clinical Topics
with one another. The Wilcoxon rank-sum tests reproduce the exploratory
comparison of each selected Clinical Topic with the overall empirical distribution.
Benjamini--Hochberg adjustment is applied across all tests in each family, and
the adjusted p-value is the primary inferential result. In this report,
adjusted p-values rounded to two decimal places at or below
`r sprintf("%.2f", significance_threshold)` are interpreted as evidence of a
distributional difference.

```{r statistical-tests}
kruskal_results <- field_metric_long %>%
  group_by(metric) %>%
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    p_value = kruskal.test(value ~ field_label_short)$p.value,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    p_adjust_bh = p.adjust(p_value, method = "BH"),
    metric_label = unname(metric_labels[metric])
  ) %>%
  arrange(p_adjust_bh)

overall_comparison_results <- map_dfr(metric_names, function(metric_name) {
  overall_values <- overall_metric_long %>%
    filter(metric == metric_name) %>%
    pull(value)

  field_metric_long %>%
    filter(metric == metric_name) %>%
    group_by(field_label_short) %>%
    summarise(
      metric = metric_name,
      n_field = n(),
      n_overall = length(overall_values),
      p_value = wilcox.test(value, overall_values, exact = FALSE)$p.value,
      median_field = median(value),
      median_overall = median(overall_values),
      mean_field = mean(value),
      mean_overall = mean(overall_values),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
}) %>%
  mutate(
    p_adjust_bh = p.adjust(p_value, method = "BH"),
    metric_label = unname(metric_labels[metric]),
    direction = case_when(
      median_field > median_overall ~ "higher",
      median_field < median_overall ~ "lower",
      TRUE ~ "equal"
    )
  ) %>%
  arrange(p_adjust_bh)

write.csv(
  kruskal_results,
  file.path(comparison_result_dir, "empirical_field_kruskal_wallis.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)
write.csv(
  overall_comparison_results,
  file.path(comparison_result_dir, "empirical_field_vs_overall_wilcoxon.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)
```

```{r test-interpretation, results='asis'}
significant_kruskal <- kruskal_results %>%
  filter(round(p_adjust_bh, 2) <= significance_threshold)
significant_wilcoxon <- overall_comparison_results %>%
  filter(round(p_adjust_bh, 2) <= significance_threshold)

if (nrow(significant_kruskal) == 0L) {
  cat(
    "No numeric metric had a Benjamini--Hochberg adjusted p-value, rounded ",
    "to two decimal places, at or below ", significance_threshold,
    " across the eligible Clinical Topics.\n\n",
    sep = ""
  )
} else {
  cat(
    "Metrics with Benjamini--Hochberg adjusted p-values, rounded to two ",
    "decimal places, at or below ", significance_threshold,
    " across eligible Clinical Topics: ",
    paste(significant_kruskal$metric_label, collapse = "; "),
    ".\n\n",
    sep = ""
  )
}

if (nrow(significant_wilcoxon) == 0L) {
  cat(
    "No Clinical Topic--metric comparison with the overall empirical distribution ",
    "had a Benjamini--Hochberg adjusted p-value, rounded to two decimal ",
    "places, at or below ", significance_threshold, ".\n\n",
    sep = ""
  )
} else {
  significant_wilcoxon %>%
    transmute(
      `Clinical Topic` = as.character(field_label_short),
      Metric = metric_label,
      Direction = direction,
      `Clinical Topic median` = sprintf("%.2f", median_field),
      `Overall median` = sprintf("%.2f", median_overall),
      `BH-adjusted p` = sprintf("%.2f", p_adjust_bh)
    ) %>%
    kable(
      caption = paste(
        "Clinical Topic--metric comparisons with Benjamini--Hochberg adjusted",
        paste0(
          "p-values rounded to two decimals at or below ",
          significance_threshold
        )
      )
    ) %>%
    print()
}
```

# Metric distributions

Each panel compares the eligible Clinical Topics with the overall empirical
distribution. Integer metrics with relatively few values use proportional bar
charts; other metrics use a histogram for the overall distribution and
frequency polygons for the selected Clinical Topics. Boxplots provide a common direct
comparison.

```{r distribution-functions}
histogram_bins <- 15L

dimension_axis_breaks <- function(minimum) {
  function(limits) {
    candidate_breaks <- breaks_pretty(n = 6)(limits)
    sort(unique(c(
      minimum,
      candidate_breaks[candidate_breaks >= minimum]
    )))
  }
}

make_metric_distribution <- function(metric_name, force_histogram = FALSE) {
  metric_label <- metric_labels[[metric_name]]
  metric_values <- metric_long %>%
    filter(metric == metric_name) %>%
    pull(value)
  integer_bars <- !force_histogram &&
    all(metric_values == round(metric_values)) &&
    n_distinct(metric_values) <= 30L

  if (integer_bars) {
    bar_data <- distribution_boxplot_metric_long %>%
      filter(metric == metric_name) %>%
      mutate(value = as.integer(round(value))) %>%
      count(field_label_plot, value, name = "n") %>%
      group_by(field_label_plot) %>%
      mutate(proportion = n / sum(n)) %>%
      ungroup()

    return(
      ggplot(
        bar_data,
        aes(x = factor(value), y = proportion, fill = field_label_plot)
      ) +
        geom_col(
          position = position_dodge2(width = 0.9, preserve = "single"),
          width = 0.8,
          color = "white",
          linewidth = 0.2
        ) +
        scale_fill_manual(
          values = c(distribution_palette, Overall = overall_fill),
          drop = FALSE
        ) +
        scale_y_continuous(labels = percent_format(accuracy = 1)) +
        labs(
          title = paste("Distribution:", metric_label),
          x = metric_label,
          y = "Proportion of networks",
          fill = "Clinical Topic"
        )
    )
  }

  distribution_plot <- ggplot() +
    geom_histogram(
      data = overall_metric_long %>% filter(metric == metric_name),
      aes(x = value, y = after_stat(count / sum(count))),
      bins = histogram_bins,
      fill = overall_fill,
      alpha = 0.4,
      color = "white",
      linewidth = 0.2
    ) +
    geom_freqpoly(
      data = distribution_field_metric_long %>%
        filter(metric == metric_name),
      aes(
        x = value,
        y = after_stat(count / ave(count, group, FUN = sum)),
        color = field_label_plot
      ),
      bins = histogram_bins,
      linewidth = 1
    ) +
    scale_color_manual(values = distribution_palette, drop = FALSE) +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = percent_format(accuracy = 1)) +
    labs(
      title = paste("Distribution:", metric_label),
      x = metric_label,
      y = "Proportion of networks",
      color = "Clinical Topic"
    )

  if (metric_name == "N_treatments") {
    distribution_plot <- distribution_plot +
      scale_x_continuous(
        limits = c(4, NA),
        breaks = dimension_axis_breaks(4),
        labels = label_number(accuracy = 1)
      )
  }

  if (metric_name == "N_total_trials") {
    distribution_plot <- distribution_plot +
      scale_x_continuous(
        limits = c(2, NA),
        breaks = dimension_axis_breaks(2),
        labels = label_number(accuracy = 1)
      )
  }

  distribution_plot
}

make_metric_boxplot <- function(metric_name) {
  boxplot <- ggplot(
    distribution_boxplot_metric_long %>% filter(metric == metric_name),
    aes(x = field_label_plot, y = value, fill = field_label_plot)
  ) +
    geom_boxplot(outlier.alpha = 0.45, width = 0.7) +
    scale_fill_manual(
      values = c(distribution_palette, Overall = overall_fill),
      drop = FALSE
    ) +
    labs(
      title = paste("Boxplot:", metric_labels[[metric_name]]),
      x = "Clinical Topic",
      y = metric_labels[[metric_name]]
    ) +
    theme(legend.position = "none")

  if (metric_name == "N_treatments") {
    boxplot <- boxplot +
      scale_y_continuous(
        limits = c(4, NA),
        breaks = dimension_axis_breaks(4),
        labels = label_number(accuracy = 1)
      )
  }

  if (metric_name == "N_total_trials") {
    boxplot <- boxplot +
      scale_y_continuous(
        limits = c(2, NA),
        breaks = dimension_axis_breaks(2),
        labels = label_number(accuracy = 1)
      )
  }

  boxplot
}
```

```{r metric-distributions, results='asis'}
plot_metric_names <- metric_names
stopifnot(all(mean_degree_metric_names %in% plot_metric_names))

for (metric_name in plot_metric_names) {
  cat("\n\n## ", metric_labels[[metric_name]], "\n\n", sep = "")
  print(make_metric_distribution(metric_name))
  print(make_metric_boxplot(metric_name))
}
```

```{r save-grouped-histograms, include=FALSE}
histogram_figure_groups <- list(
  density = list(
    metrics = c("density", "bi_density")
  ),
  mean_degree = list(
    metrics = c(
      "mean_unipartite_unweighted_degree",
      "mean_bipartite_trial_degree",
      "mean_bipartite_treatment_degree"
    )
  ),
  clustering_apl = list(
    metrics = c("unipartite_c", "avg_path_length")
  ),
  degree_assortativity = list(
    metrics = c("assortativity", "bi_assortativity")
  ),
  degree_irregularity = list(
    metrics = c(
      "deg_irreg",
      "bi_trial_deg_irreg",
      "bi_treatment_deg_irreg"
    )
  ),
  network_size = list(
    metrics = c("N_total_trials", "N_treatments")
  ),
  edge_counts = list(
    metrics = c("number_of_distinct_treatment_comparisons", "number_of_arms")
  )
)

stopifnot(all(
  unlist(map(histogram_figure_groups, "metrics")) %in% metric_names
))

iwalk(histogram_figure_groups, function(group, group_name) {
  panel_count <- length(group$metrics)
  panel_subtitles <- if (group_name == "edge_counts") {
    c(
      "(a)",
      "(b)"
    )
  } else {
    paste0("(", letters[seq_len(panel_count)], ")")
  }
  grouped_plot <- wrap_plots(
    map2(
      group$metrics,
      panel_subtitles,
      ~ make_metric_distribution(.x, force_histogram = TRUE) +
        labs(title = NULL, subtitle = .y)
    ),
    ncol = panel_count,
    guides = "collect"
  ) &
    theme(
      legend.position = "bottom",
      plot.subtitle = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5)
    )

  print(grouped_plot)
})
```

# Conclusion

```{r conclusion-values, include=FALSE}
kw_adjusted_p <- setNames(
  kruskal_results$p_adjust_bh,
  kruskal_results$metric
)
neoplasms_results <- overall_comparison_results %>%
  filter(as.character(field_label_short) == "02") %>%
  select(metric, p_adjust_bh)
neoplasms_adjusted_p <- setNames(
  neoplasms_results$p_adjust_bh,
  neoplasms_results$metric
)
```

Using unrounded Benjamini--Hochberg adjusted p-values below
`r sprintf("%.2f", significance_threshold)`, the Kruskal--Wallis tests
selected `r sum(kruskal_results$p_adjust_bh < significance_threshold, na.rm = TRUE)`
metrics: `r paste(kruskal_results$metric_label[kruskal_results$p_adjust_bh < significance_threshold], collapse = "; ")`.
The number of arms differed across Clinical Topics (adjusted \(p =\)
`r sprintf("%.3f", kw_adjusted_p[["number_of_arms"]])`), while the number
of distinct treatment comparisons did not meet this criterion (adjusted
\(p =\) `r sprintf("%.3f", kw_adjusted_p[["number_of_distinct_treatment_comparisons"]])`).
These omnibus tests do not identify which individual Clinical Topics differ.

In the exploratory comparison of Clinical Topic 02 with the overall empirical
distribution, the median number of arms was
`r summary_table$median[summary_table$metric == "number_of_arms" & summary_table$field_label_short == "02"]`
versus
`r summary_table$median[summary_table$metric == "number_of_arms" & summary_table$field_label_short == "Overall"]`
(adjusted \(p =\) `r sprintf("%.3f", neoplasms_adjusted_p[["number_of_arms"]])`).
Because each Clinical Topic is contained in the overall sample, these
Clinical Topic-versus-overall findings should remain exploratory and should
not be interpreted as causal effects of Clinical Topic membership.
